svg.title: Shopme static e-commerce site on AWS — architecture
svg.desc: Visitors reach Amazon CloudFront over HTTPS. AWS WAF and an ACM certificate (us-east-1) attach to the distribution. CloudFront reads two private, versioned S3 buckets (website and images) through Origin Access Control. Optional cross-region replication copies both buckets to a secondary region. A CloudWatch dashboard shows requests. GitHub Actions syncs site files to S3 and invalidates the CloudFront cache.
svg.text: Shopme — static e-commerce site on AWS
S3 + CloudFront (OAC) + WAF + CloudWatch, optional cross-region DR — provisioned with CloudFormation, deployed with GitHub Actions
required region for CloudFront-scope WAF & ACM
Viewer request path (HTTPS → CloudFront → private S3 origins via OAC)
Deploy path (push to main → S3 sync + CloudFront invalidation)
Optional component — WAF, ACM custom domain, DR stack, replication role
